resources.name: Open‑source DFT code (e.g., NWChem, CP2K, ORCA)

access.notes: Any DFT program that supports LDA (Dirac exchange + VWN correlation), gradient‑corrected functionals (Becke exchange, Perdew correlation, Perdew 86), perturbative nonlocal corrections (VWN+BP), and custom basis sets can be used.

resources.name: DZVP basis set for Si and H

access.notes: Double‑zeta‑split‑valence plus polarization basis sets for Si and H as described in ref. 13 of the source paper. Obtain from Basis Set Exchange (e.g., the DGauss/DZVP basis).

resources.name: TZVPP basis set for Si and H

access.notes: Triple‑zeta plus polarization basis set: Si (13s9p1d)/[5s4p1d] contraction from Godbout's DZVPP and H cc‑TZP from Dunning. Obtain from Basis Set Exchange.
